brief:
Israeli Arab-led parties achieved record voter turnout in national elections, according to Zeteo, potentially positioning them to influence coalition negotiations following a dramatic electoral outcome. The report noted that Zionist political figures characterized the Arab participation as significant, though the exact number of seats gained and their role in forming a government remained unclear from available accounts.

The development marks a shift in Arab political participation within Israel's electoral system, as parties representing Arab citizens historically faced barriers to meaningful coalition influence.
dek: After a dramatic election, could Arab-led parties influence the Israeli balance of power? Plus, beaten Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro flees to the U.S. for Trump’s protection.
title: Arab-led parties gain seats in Israeli election, claim record turnout
